findings.text: blocking: the return type is narrowed from dict[str, Any] | None to None, dropping the {"plan_link", "unplanned_reason"} value that reckon/crew/promotion.py:1500-1501 passes to ledger build_record, so every brief landing now records no plan owner; measured in a scratch extraction of each revision, tests/test_promotion_records_a_brief_runs_owner.py is 7 passed at 9cbf82e8 and 4 failed at 8219303b (test_a_plan_link_lands_on_the_row, test_an_unplanned_reason_lands_on_the_row, test_the_cli_plan_link_reaches_the_row, test_the_cli_unplanned_reason_reaches_the_row), the head failure reading assert None == 'a probe changes no plan'.

blocking: the added case asserts _require_brief_owner(...) is None for the recorded-discharge input, which enshrines the dropped return; restoring the discharge dict reddens this assertion, so the repair to promotion_checks.py:1775 must change this expectation with it.

non-blocking: the manifest's armed gate runs only tests/test_a_brief_run_names_its_plan_at_dispatch.py and tests/test_brief_dispatch.py although the change reaches every test importing reckon.crew, so the fold's regression surfaced in tests/test_promotion_records_a_brief_runs_owner.py only when this review ran it; the after arm should carry the importer population the done_when names.

justifications.it: reckon/crew/node.py:1202 sits beside the other contract findings with a mechanism docstring, reuses EXECUTABLE_SECTION_ROLES from reckon/evidence.py:382, and introduces no plan or stage identifier.
justifications.oal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1775 narrows _require_brief_owner to return None, so the discharge that reckon/crew/promotion.py:1500 writes onto the ledger row is now always empty.
justifications.urability: tests/test_a_brief_run_names_its_plan_at_dispatch.py:545 genuinely reddens on a divergence between the two refusals, but the same commit leaves tests/test_promotion_records_a_brief_runs_owner.py with 4 failures and adds tests/test_a_brief_run_names_its_plan_at_dispatch.py:571 asserting the broken return is None.
justifications.vidence: logs/armed-base-suite.log and logs/armed-head-suite.log are proper receipts for two files, but the done_when's importer clause was never measured and the omission hid four failures in tests/test_promotion_records_a_brief_runs_owner.py.
